# unraid_api_keys (Data Source)

Metadata of all API keys. The secret key values are never read. Requires `READ_ANY` on `API_KEY`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unraid_api_keys" "all" {}

output "admin_keys" {
  value = [for k in data.unraid_api_keys.all.api_keys : k.name if contains(k.roles, "ADMIN")]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `permissions` (Attributes List) Explicit permissions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_keys--permissions))
- `roles` (List of String) Roles: `ADMIN`, `CONNECT`, `GUEST`, `VIEWER`.
